Fed all 2,000 hidden inputs to the rebuilt artifact binary; it emitted OUTPUT_BYTES=0. tests/support.py:96-104 therefore counts 0 matching lines out of 2,000, giving behaviour=0.
No surprise component appeared, so no cheat fix or second run was needed for cheat 3.
why_it_matters: This is an exact demonstration of the unconditional 2/6 floor: a program with zero correct answers still scores 0.3333 purely for building and having no .py files in the workspace.
